title: Start ECall Request
description: Backs taf_ecall_StartTest/StartManual/StartAutomatic (type=TEST/MANUAL/AUTOMATIC, ICallManager::makeECall's regulatory overloads) and taf_ecall_StartPrivate (type=PRIVATE, the dialNumber+SIP-header overload). Mirrors CallManagerServerImpl::MakeECall / tel_simulation.proto's MakeECallRequest, which never carried actual MSD bytes on the wire (the server only simulates HLAP protocol timing, not MSD content) -- isMsdTransmitted is the only MSD-related field here, same as upstream.

remotePartyNumber.description: Overridden/custom PSAP number for a regulatory eCall (taf_ecall_SetPsapNumber). Empty/absent dials the default regulatory emergency number -- mirrors CallManagerStub's createRequest<T>()'s 'if (dialNumber != "") // Regulatory eCall' branch.

dialNumber.description: Dial number for type=PRIVATE only (SIP/TPS eCall).
